name: CMMMU
intro: CMMMU是面向中文环境的大规模多学科多模态理解基准，评估大型多模态模型在需要大学水平学科知识和推理的任务表现。包含来自六大核心学科、30个专业和39种图像类型的12000个手工收集多模态问题，旨在推动下一代专家级多模态AI发展。
org: 01.AI, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
build_method: 组织者与本科及以上标注员从许可合规网站和书籍手工收集，经图像依赖、重复、大学难度、作者逐题核验与多模型污染过滤
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答
eval_feature: 中文大学多模态知识, 39类图像, 规则答案抽取, 微平均准确率, 错例分析
scale: 12,000道题、6大学科、30多个专业、39类图像
build_method_en: Organizers and undergraduate-or-higher annotators manually collect from license-compliant sites and books, followed by image-dependence, duplication, college-level, author-verification, and multi-model contamination filters
eval_feature_en: Chinese college-level multimodal knowledge, 39 image types, rule-based extraction, micro accuracy, error analysis
intro_en: CMMMU is a large-scale multidisciplinary multimodal understanding benchmark for the Chinese context, evaluating the performance of large multimodal models on tasks requiring university-level disciplinary knowledge and reasoning. It includes 12,000 manually collected multimodal questions from six core disciplines, 30 specialties, and 39 image types, aiming to advance the development of next-generation expert-level multimodal AI.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.11944. CMMMU follows a three-stage collection process: author organizers gather license-compliant websites or book sources with at least 20 annotation sources per subject in each discipline; undergraduate-or-higher annotators create questions while filtering image-independent, duplicate-image, non-expert, and repetitive knowledge-point items; organizers supplement sparse subjects to balance the dataset. Quality control manually verifies every question by at least one paper author, removes items below college-exam level or hard-to-extract answer format, and filters contamination by excluding questions simultaneously solved by GPT-4, Qwen-7B, Deepseek-7B, and Yi-7B without OCR. The resulting 12K-item benchmark spans six disciplines, over 30 subjects, 39 image types, and multiple question formats, and uses a rule-based extraction pipeline with micro-average accuracy.
